theorems.statement: ∀ (γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (ε p q : ℤ), ε ^ 2 = 1 → IsCoprime p q → (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ).mulVec ![p, q] = ![ε * p, ε * q] → ∃ (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (b : ℤ), (σ⁻¹ * γ * σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ).val = Matrix.of ![![ε, b], ![0, ε]]
theorems.natural_summary: Use the pinned Bézout completion lemma to choose σ with first column (p,q). Conjugation transports the eigenvector equation to give first column (ε,0). Determinant one yields εd=1, and ε²=1 forces d=ε; choose the upper-right entry as b. This matches the accepted parent-supplied proof.
